name: Reefwalker Ocean Discovery Tours
summary: Whale watching, sunset coastal cliff cruises, crayfish pot pulling and deep sea fishing charters from Kalbarri on the Coral Coast. Trips leave from the Kalbarri Maritime Facility on Isle G, a 50ft vessel licensed to carry up to 29 passengers. The business was started by the late Robert Curic in 1992 and is now run by his son, Aydan Curic.
standouts: Family business established in 1992, now run by owner and skipper Aydan Curic
Isle G is a 50ft West Coaster licensed to carry up to 29 passengers, with a shaded deck, seating and toilets
No minimum age on tours; children under 3 travel free
Passengers may bring their own alcohol on board, with glasses and an ice box provided

contact.address: Kalbarri Maritime Facility, Grey Street, Kalbarri WA 6536

trips.title: Kalbarri Sunset Coastal Cliff Cruise
trips.summary: A sunset cruise of about 90 minutes on Isle G along the Kalbarri coastal cliffs, where the cliffs meet the Indian Ocean. It suits the end of a day spent exploring on land. Guests can bring their own drinks on board.
highlights: Sunset cruise along the Kalbarri coastal cliffs
Bring your own drinks; glasses and an ice box provided
Shaded deck with seating and toilets on Isle G

trips.title: Kalbarri Whale Watching Tour
trips.summary: A cruise of about two hours along the Kalbarri coastline during the humpback whale migration season, watching the whales' migrating behaviour. Whales are wild, so where they are found and how long it takes to find them varies. There is no minimum age, and children under 3 are free.
highlights: Humpback whale watching along the Kalbarri coastline
Runs during the whale migration season

trips.title: Kalbarri Crayfish Catch & Keep Tour
trips.summary: A hands-on cruise of about 90 minutes where guests haul pots to catch Western Rock Lobster, guided by the crew. It is run as a catch and keep tour. Own drinks are allowed on board.
highlights: Haul the pots to catch Western Rock Lobster
Interactive trip guided by the crew

trips.title: Kalbarri Deep Sea Fishing Charter
trips.summary: A deep sea fishing charter of about 8 hours for beginners and experienced anglers, with single line or share line options. Target species depend on the season and include pink snapper, dhufish, coral trout, red emperor, bald chin groper, Spanish mackerel, yellowfin tuna and sharks. All ages are welcome on board.
highlights: Single line or share line options
Runs from 16 December to 14 October each year

checkNotes: Domain: https://reefwalker.com.au does not load over https (it presents a Squarespace certificate for other names); the http address redirects to https://www.reefwalker.com.au, which is the same business, and every page here was read there. No other business's domain is involved. Name: the site header, page titles and About page say 'Reefwalker Ocean Discovery Tours'; the FAQ and terms page say 'Reefwalker Ocean Discovery'. The booking account is 'reefwalkercharters' and the review links on the Contact page name 'Reefwalker Charters Kalbarri'; these look like the same business under an earlier name, but a person should confirm the Rezdy account belongs to this operator. Prices: the site shows only a 'From' price for each trip and the full ticket list sits in the booking system, which was not opened (Rezdy pages are not fetched), so each trip has one price option only. The FAQ gives the child ticket age range as 3 to 12 and says under 3s are free, but no child price is shown. Departure times and the whale watching season are not stated anywhere on the site. The Book Now button in the menu links to the booking catalogue (https://reefwalkercharters.rezdy.com/catalog/387893/tours), not to a single trip; it is not recorded as a trip link, and the catalogue may list more trips than the four on the site. Sighting guarantee: the FAQ and terms page promise a sighting guarantee with a free return voucher; left out of the copy. Cancellations (terms page): must be in writing, not by phone; fees rise as departure gets closer and nothing is refunded within 12 hours of departure; weather cancellations by the operator offer a full refund or a reschedule; missed tours and seasickness are not refunded or rescheduled. Phone shown on the site as 0417 931 091. No land-only activities, hire or other businesses' trips were found. No gift vouchers or offers are shown on the site.
